method.cost: One bias-free hidden-by-hidden projection in each experimental arm, plus O(batch × length × hidden²) projection work. GPU runtime is unmeasured.
method.mechanism: Agent hypothesis: after the existing normalized encoder states are formed, add a small learned residual from the local change x_t - x_previous to the incumbent final representation. The generated control uses x_t + x_previous with the same projection, initialization, residual scale, and predecessor mask. Both arms retain the incumbent uniform context, compression, and 0.85/0.15 blend. The candidate-control contrast tests local change against local co-activation; ranking attribution remains provisional.
